summary: Frontend-only Mentor Dashboard tested end-to-end via Playwright at public preview URL. Dashboard KPIs, charts, all 7 sidebar routes, students table (search + batch filter + pagination), student profile (STU-1001), Daily Tracker, Leaderboard tabs, Announcements create + pin, Reports tabs + export button, Settings save + notifications, dark mode (settings toggle + persistence after reload), and tablet responsive sidebar all verified. Zero console errors detected. Only issue: topbar theme-toggle click did not flip the html.dark class in the test run (settings theme-toggle works, and theme persists across reload, so dark mode itself is functional).
passed: Dashboard loads at / with all 8 KPI test-ids (kpi-total, kpi-active, kpi-pending, kpi-risk, kpi-hours, kpi-attendance, kpi-mcq, kpi-submission)
Multiple Recharts SVGs render on Dashboard, StudentProfile, DailyTracker, Leaderboard, Reports
All 7 sidebar nav items (nav-dashboard/students/daily-tracker/leaderboard/announcements/reports/settings) navigate to correct routes
Students page: student-search narrows rows (8 -> 1), filter-batch/attempt/group/status visible, batch Super 30 filter applies, page-next/page-prev work
view-STU-1001 opens /students/STU-1001 profile with charts and heatmap
Daily Tracker: tracker-batch and >=7 day buttons visible
Announcements: title + body + publish creates new item visible in list; pin-ANN toggles
Reports: report-tab-batch, report-tab-student, export-btn all visible; tabs switch
Settings: settings-name/email inputs, save-profile shows 'Saved!' text
Dark mode persists after full page reload (localStorage)
Tablet (768px): topbar-menu-btn visible and opens sidebar
No console errors on any route

failed.issue: Clicking [data-testid=theme-toggle] in topbar did not change html.dark class in this run (state was same before/after click)
failed.evidence: Playwright before/after evaluate on document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') returned the same value. Settings theme-toggle works and persistence via localStorage works, so dark mode logic is functional overall.

action_items: Verify the topbar theme-toggle button handler actually calls the same theme setter as settings toggle; possible cause: button click intercepted by a following DOM update or handler bound to different state. Non-blocking for first finish since alternative toggle works.
